cases.input_condition: A claim omits a required company or period field.
cases.expected_behavior: Input validation fails before graph or rule evaluation.

cases.input_condition: A finding references a claim whose evidence edge is absent.
cases.expected_behavior: Evidence linkage validation reports an error with the finding and evidence IDs.
No StandardReference edge or compliance/violation conclusion is created.

cases.input_condition: A required rule record is absent rather than explicitly present with a null value.
cases.expected_behavior: The rule does not run and does not create Contradicted or InsufficientEvidence.

cases.input_condition: Two annual records have different unexplained verified reporting boundaries.
cases.expected_behavior: The pair is NeedsReview with comparison_performed=false.

cases.input_condition: The same exact finding is supplied twice under different IDs.
cases.expected_behavior: Company aggregation counts the finding once and records the exact duplicate removal.

cases.input_condition: BSR Scope 1 values C15 and C16 differ in the normalized extract.
cases.expected_behavior: Retain NeedsReview until reporting boundary and both PDF source locations are manually adjudicated.

cases.input_condition: BSR board_total is linked for report/observation years 2023, 2024 and 2025.
cases.expected_behavior: Keep both pairs NeedsReview because period type, boundary and original source text are not verified.
